extracted.intended_audience: publishers, academic institutions, researchers, medical affairs teams, corporate R&D, nonprofits and research administrators
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and product-oriented criteria for measuring and visualizing online attention to published research (social media, news, policy, patents, etc.), including tools (Explorer, Badges, API) and service offerings (consultancy).

rubrics_metrics.name: Online attention sources tracked
rubrics_metrics.description: Altmetric tracks and captures a range of online attention sources to published research across social media, news outlets, policy and more.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: We collate this activity, to help you monitor, report and showcase the attention surrounding the research you care about.

rubrics_metrics.name: Timeliness / speed of attention tracking
rubrics_metrics.description: Reveal online attention to research at speed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Thousands of conversations about research happen online every day; Altmetric surfaces that attention quickly so you can monitor and respond in a timely way.

rubrics_metrics.name: Coverage breadth (sectors and mention types)
rubrics_metrics.description: Uncover the wider influence of published research by tracking mentions across social media, mainstream media, policy, patents and more.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Tracks thousands of online mentions across multiple channels to show influence beyond academia and across sectors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Comparability and exploration (Altmetric Explorer)
rubrics_metrics.description: Altmetric Explorer: Access and compare online attention to research, as Altmetric tracks thousands of online mentions across social media, mainstream media, policy, patents and more all in one platform.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use Explorer to access, filter and compare attention across outputs, authors, institutions and time periods.

rubrics_metrics.name: Visual summary / badge-based dissemination (Altmetric Badges)
rubrics_metrics.description: Altmetric Badges: Quickly view and understand the dissemination of research at a glance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Complement traditional citation analysis with Altmetric Badges. Each badge compiles and consolidates online attention to research, so you can instantly visualize and interpret online attention.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recognizable visualization (the Altmetric doughnut)
rubrics_metrics.description: The Altmetric doughnut has long been a recognisable staple in the research landscape — helping…
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The doughnut provides an at-a-glance visual summary of dissemination and attention; useful for quickly communicating impact to stakeholders.

rubrics_metrics.name: Flexible data access and custom analysis (Altmetric API)
rubrics_metrics.description: Altmetric API: Leverage Altmetric data in the way that works best for your organization.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Conduct more complex searches, ask granular questions, build custom visualizations and merge your own data with the Altmetric API.

rubrics_metrics.name: Custom insight and bespoke dashboards (Altmetric Consultancy)
rubrics_metrics.description: Altmetric Consultancy: Have your questions answered, as our team creates customized and accurate dashboards in the way you need it.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Tell us your needs and our friendly data analysts can help you create a solution based on your exact requirements; they can even help you uncover solutions you hadn’t thought possible.

rubrics_metrics.name: Complement to traditional citation analysis
rubrics_metrics.description: Complement traditional citation analysis with Altmetric Badges.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Move beyond citations and listen in on the conversation — use online attention metrics to complement citation-based impact measures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sentiment as a dimension of attention (use case for Medical Affairs)
rubrics_metrics.description: Understanding attention with sentiment in Medical Affairs: For Medical Affairs teams, “impact” has often been measured by volume: how many times a…
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use sentiment analysis to go beyond volume counts and understand the tone and quality of attention (especially relevant in medical/clinical communications and reputation tracking).

rubrics_metrics.name: Use-case and stakeholder reporting (institutions, accreditation, admin needs)
rubrics_metrics.description: Use Altmetric to support institutional impact, accreditation, and research-administration reporting (examples include Business School Accreditation, institutional user days, and impact/strategy sessions).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Altmetric can be used to build evidence for institutional reporting, accreditation processes, promotional cases, and strategic assessment of research dissemination.

rubrics_metrics.name: Event- and training-oriented dissemination of best practice
rubrics_metrics.description: On-demand webinars and user days that highlight new features, use cases, and how to implement Altmetric for impact analysis and institutional strategy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Attend webinars (e.g., 'Altmetric Update', 'Using Altmetric for Impact Analysis') to learn how to interpret metrics, implement tools, and align altmetrics with organizational goals.
